citations.label: SQL [Calculate average battery cycle count grouped by device model] (3 rows)

queries.sql: SELECT model_name, ROUND(CAST(AVG(battery_cycle_count) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS avg_battery_cycle_count, COUNT(*) AS device_count FROM telemetry.v_latest_device_state WHERE battery_present = TRUE GROUP BY model_name ORDER BY avg_battery_cycle_count DESC LIMIT 200
